sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Configuration Management Plan establishes baseline standards and inventory controls for {system_name} operated by {org_name}. It applies within {boundary} to safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information including {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Baseline Configuration Establishment and Maintenance

questions.prompt: How is the baseline configuration established?
What hardware software firmware and documentation are included in the baseline?
How is the baseline configuration maintained throughout the system lifecycle?

sections.body: The system baseline configuration is established through {baseline_establishment}. The baseline includes hardware software firmware and documentation as specified by {baseline_components}. Maintenance of the baseline configuration occurs via {baseline_maintenance}.

sections.heading: 3. System Inventory Control

questions.prompt: How is the system inventory established?
What hardware software firmware and documentation items are tracked in the inventory?
How is the system inventory maintained and updated?

sections.body: The system inventory is established by {inventory_establishment}. The inventory encompasses hardware software firmware and documentation detailing {inventory_components}. Updates and reviews of the inventory are performed through {inventory_maintenance}.

sections.heading: 4. Security Configuration Settings

questions.prompt: How are security configuration settings established and included in the baseline?
How are security configuration settings enforced on information technology products?

sections.body: Security configuration settings for information technology products are established by {security_settings_def}. Enforcement of security configuration settings across system components is achieved through {security_settings_enf}.
